request.description: Add a new line to an internal account for a given share class. This enables the investor to hold and subscribe to that share class within the account. Returns 409 if the account already has a line for the specified share class.

request.description:
**Retrieve virtual IBAN deposit instructions for a given account, share class, and subscription currency.**

Returns a list of virtual bank accounts, each with its supported payment rails. An empty list means no virtual bank account has been provisioned (feature not available).

Each entry includes payment informations and supported rails:
- `SCT` / `SCT Instant` - SEPA Credit Transfer (EUR)
- `Faster Payments` / `CHAPS` / `BACS` - UK local transfers (GBP); also includes `gbpLocalDetails` with sort code and account number
- `SWIFT` - international wire
